mapper.select: select m.major_id as majorId, m.major_code as majorCode, m.major_name as majorName, m.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, m.education_level as educationLevel, m.duration as duration from brm_major m left join brm_department d on m.dept_id = d.dept_id where m.major_id = #{majorId} and m.status = '0' limit 1

select m.major_id as majorId, m.major_code as majorCode, m.major_name as majorName, d.dept_name as deptName, m.education_level as educationLevel from brm_major m left join brm_department d on m.dept_id = d.dept_id where m.status = '0' order by m.dept_id, m.major_code

select tp.plan_id as planId, tp.plan_name as planName, tp.plan_year as planYear, tp.version as version, tp.total_credits as totalCredits, tp.publish_date as publishDate from tpm_training_plan tp where tp.major_id = #{majorId} and tp.del_flag = '0' and tp.publish_status = '1' order by tp.plan_year desc, tp.plan_id desc

select count(1) as totalCount, coalesce(sum(case when s.student_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as enrolledCount, coalesce(sum(case when s.student_status = '3' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as graduatedCount from sam_student s where s.major_id = #{majorId} and s.status = '0'

select count(1) as teacherCount, coalesce(sum(case when t.title in ('教授','副教授') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as seniorCount, coalesce(sum(case when t.education in ('博士','博士研究生') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as doctorCount from brm_teacher t where t.dept_id = #{deptId} and t.status = '0'
select coalesce(t.title, '未填写') as title, count(1) as cnt from brm_teacher t where t.dept_id = #{deptId} and t.status = '0' group by t.title order by cnt desc
select coalesce(t.education, '未填写') as education, count(1) as cnt from brm_teacher t where t.dept_id = #{deptId} and t.status = '0' group by t.education order by cnt desc

select count(1) as courseCount, coalesce(sum(cl.credit), 0) as totalCredit, coalesce(sum(case when cl.course_category = '实践环节' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as practiceCount, coalesce(sum(case when cl.course_category = '实践环节' then cl.credit else 0 end), 0) as practiceCredit, coalesce(sum(cl.practice_hours), 0) as practiceHours, coalesce(sum(cl.total_hours), 0) as totalHours from tpm_course_library cl where cl.plan_id = #{planId} and cl.del_flag = '0' and cl.status = '0'

select cs.credit_type as creditType, cs.credit_type_name as creditTypeName, cs.required_credit as requiredCredit from tpm_credit_structure cs where cs.plan_id = #{planId} and cs.del_flag = '0' order by cs.struct_id

select count(1) as offeringCount, coalesce(sum(o.class_count), 0) as classCount from tpm_course_offering o join tpm_course_library cl on cl.course_id = o.course_id where cl.plan_id = #{planId} and cl.del_flag = '0' and o.del_flag = '0' and o.status = '0'

select count(1) as evalCount, round(avg(er.total_score), 2) as avgScore, coalesce(sum(case when er.total_score >= 90 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as excellentCount from aem_evaluation_result er join brm_teacher t on er.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where t.dept_id = #{deptId} and t.status = '0' and er.status = '0'

select count(1) as recordCount, round(avg(sr.evaluation_score), 2) as avgScore, coalesce(sum(case when sr.evaluation_level = '3' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unqualifiedCount from aem_supervision_record sr join brm_teacher t on sr.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where t.dept_id = #{deptId} and t.status = '0' and sr.status = '0'

select sr.evaluation_level as level, count(1) as cnt from aem_supervision_record sr join brm_teacher t on sr.teacher_id = t.teacher_id where t.dept_id = #{deptId} and t.status = '0' and sr.status = '0' group by sr.evaluation_level order by sr.evaluation_level
